name: eu
title: The European Union
desc: Orthographic, in the Wikipedia locator style.
how: Paint: Group, European Union (27). Style: Wikipedia preset.
source: Natural Earth; membership checked against the European Union's EU countries page.
alt: Orthographic globe centred on Europe with the 27 European Union members in green

name: gdp
title: GDP per capita, 2022
desc: Equal Earth. World Bank data fetched on {fetched}, five classes by quantile; countries without a value are marked.
how: Data: Statistic, GDP per capita, year 2022; quantiles.
source: World Bank, World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0).
alt: World map in Equal Earth projection, countries shaded by GDP per capita in five classes

name: althist
title: A restored Byzantium, 1453
desc: A fictional scenario: the regions and arrows are freehand and invented. Only the coastlines and country borders underneath are real data.
source: Invented, over Natural Earth's present-day borders; its exports say it is fictional.
alt: Globe of the eastern Mediterranean showing a fictional 1453, with empires drawn as regions and campaigns as arrows

name: uk
title: The countries of the United Kingdom
desc: Lambert conformal conic. Exact outlines from Natural Earth subdivisions.
how: Draw: Exact outline, United Kingdom, by constituent part.
alt: Lambert conformal conic map of the United Kingdom with England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland outlined

name: electoral
title: Electoral votes per state, 2024 and 2028
desc: Lambert conformal conic. Each state's electoral votes from the 2020 Census apportionment, in three classes.
how: Data: Statistic, Electoral votes per state.
source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 apportionment (public domain), checked against the Census table.
alt: Map of the United States with the states shaded by their number of electoral votes, California and Texas darkest

name: lifeexp
title: Life expectancy at birth
desc: Robinson. World Bank data fetched on {fetched}, for {year}, the latest year with good coverage.
how: Data: Statistic, Life expectancy at birth.
source: World Bank, World Development Indicators; collected by the UN Population Division (CC BY 4.0).
alt: World map in Robinson projection, countries shaded by life expectancy at birth

name: nato
title: NATO members by when they joined
desc: Globe over the North Atlantic. The year each country joined, from NATO's member countries page (read on {read}), in four periods; countries that are not members are left unpainted. Greenland, part of the Kingdom of Denmark, is a separate place on the map and is left unpainted too.
how: Data: paste a table of countries and periods; words become categories.
alt: Globe over the North Atlantic with NATO members colored by the period in which they joined

name: euro
title: The euro area within the EU
desc: Orthographic. Euro area members in solid color, the other EU members hatched.
how: Paint: Group, European Union (27), with a hatch pattern; then Group, Eurozone (21) in a solid color.
source: Membership checked against the European Union's EU countries page and the European Central Bank.
alt: Globe centred on Europe with euro area members in solid blue and the other EU members hatched

name: continents
title: Continents
desc: Robinson. Continents as in the UN's M49 classification, the Americas split by its sub-regions, in color-blind safe Okabe–Ito colors.
how: Paint: Okabe–Ito colors, then Group, each continent.
source: UN Statistics Division, M49 classification; Natural Earth borders.
alt: World map in Robinson projection with each continent in a different color

name: texas
title: The counties of Texas
desc: Lambert conformal conic. All 254 counties, from the Census Bureau's 2024 boundaries, colored so that neighbouring counties always differ.
how: Paint: Subdivisions, Layer for the United States: Counties; Detail: Constituent parts paints a whole state.
source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 cartographic boundaries (public domain).
alt: Map of Texas with its 254 counties outlined

name: ireland
title: Ireland's four provinces
desc: Lambert conformal conic. The provinces, painted from the counties layer's 26 counties a province at a time. Ulster's other six counties are in Northern Ireland, part of the United Kingdom, and are left unpainted.
how: Paint: Subdivisions, Layer for Ireland: Counties; Detail: Regions.
alt: Map of Ireland colored by its four provinces

name: mortality
title: Under-5 mortality, in a color-blind safe scale
desc: Equal Earth. World Bank data fetched on {fetched}, for {year}, in Viridis, which reads the same with the common color-vision deficiencies.
how: Data: Statistic, Under-5 mortality; scale Viridis. Style: Color vision preview to check.
source: World Bank, World Development Indicators; UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (CC BY 4.0).
alt: World map in Equal Earth projection, countries shaded by under-5 mortality in the Viridis scale
